headline: Async standups without the meeting.
body: Share yesterday, today, and blockers asynchronously — when your team is ready.

home.featureClockBody: The reminder arrives at the start of your work day, in your time zone.
home.featureHelpBody: The summary leads with who is stuck, then today, then yesterday.
home.featureDigestBody: The daily summary is posted in Slack.
home.stepOneBody: Sign in and choose the team you are posting for.
home.stepTwoBody: Yesterday, today, and anything you need help with.
home.stepThreeBody: Needs help stays open. Yesterday stays collapsed.
home.closeBody: Sign in and write today's standup.
